title: Repository facts resolve parameters without inventing policy
expected_summary: Uses the repository's archive limit, leaves the externally controlled retention value unresolved, and distinguishes facts from strategic decisions.

turns.user: Review and clean up SPEC.md using the repository evidence.
assertions: Reads the supplied archive contract and incorporates or references its 500-event limit accurately.
Leaves retention parameterized with its policy authority and reports that the policy value is unavailable.
Does not invent a retention duration, claim legal compliance, or ask the user to supply a reversible setting already available in the repository.
Distinguishes explicit factual dependencies from unresolved strategic decisions.
Does not invent a retention duration. Mentioning an unsupported duration to explicitly reject it is allowed.
